title: Glory Be My Song
lyrics: [Badd9]Yesterday, I thought I heard you [B7]speak to me,
And I [C#m]can't get it out of my [F#]head.
So [Badd9]hard to sing the words behind the [B7]melody;
But there's [F#]no way to speak it.
[Badd9]You and me - it's beyond my wildest [B7]fantasy
For the [F#]whole world to sing it.
I've got a song in my soul and it sings for You. (10x)
